## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

No cross-language parallels or early external alignments are documented for this text [DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus demonstrates extensive Pali-internal formulaic reuse across 27 texts (167 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Outside of its extensive commentary in the *Vimānavatthu-aṭṭhakathā*, the text shares substantial passage material with subsequent "chair/throne" stories, specifically the *Dutiyapīṭhavimānavatthu* (Vv 2, where segments §0.1–9.1 align with §0.1–8.1), *Tatiyapīṭhavimānavatthu* (Vv 3), and *Catutthapīṭhavimānavatthu* (Vv 4), as well as other *Vimānavatthu* narratives including the *Guttilavimānavatthu* (Vv 33), *Dīpavimānavatthu* (Vv 9), *Tatiyanāvāvimānavatthu* (Vv 8), and the *Petavatthu-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
